summary: Clearwater County, ID lookout: 1914 crow's nest, 1920 platform, 1934 50-ft L-4 tower; destroyed 1972 per two sites (one says removed); site today not described.

facts.design: 50-foot tower with L-4 cab (1934); earlier crow's nest with log cabin (1914) and 45-foot platform (1920)
facts.status_note: Destroyed 1972 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; Forest Lookouts lists it as Removed, undated

staffing.status: one staff entry: 1925, identified only as Brad

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up; no source describes what remains there now

corrections.why: 13.7 m is 45 feet, the 1920 platform height. The later L-4 tower is listed as 50 feet (about 15.2 m) on both firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1913 Clearwater TPA report already names the site Stocking Meadows Lookout, while firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the first crow's nest and log cabin to 1914. The record keeps 1914 as the built event and the story reports both dates.
firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the tower was destroyed in 1972. Forest Lookouts lists it as Removed with no date. The record keeps gone with 1972 destroyed and notes the Removed listing.

notes_for_editor: Brief's access 'unknown' kept: no source gives an access level, so the access key is omitted. Brief's height 13.7 m matches the 1920 platform; the tower is 50 ft. Fate disagrees: 1972 destroyed (two sites) vs Removed (Forest Lookouts, undated). The 1913 TPA report predates the 1914 crow's nest date. Staff entry is first name only. No source describes the site today; the Drive-Up tag is a label, not a condition.
